root_causes.finding: podFindAndDeployOnDemand returns a pod id even when no machine is allocated. The REST API returns 500 'There are no instances currently available' for the same request. GraphQL's silent success is why two A100 attempts looked deployed and billed while never starting.
root_causes.fix: use rest.runpod.io for creation; it fails loudly

root_causes.finding: cloudType COMMUNITY (and ALL, which resolves to it first) had no capacity for any probed GPU; SECURE had capacity immediately.
root_causes.fix: probe SECURE, do not assume ALL finds anything

root_causes.finding: RunPod populates pod.runtime from an agent it runs inside the container. Overriding dockerEntrypoint (or passing dockerArgs that replace the command) means that agent never runs, so runtime stays null permanently even when the container itself is healthy. Waiting on runtime is therefore the wrong readiness signal.
root_causes.fix: do not override dockerEntrypoint; poll the HTTP proxy endpoint for readiness instead of pod.runtime
